sloka: ते तु सर्वे महत्मानो भिमवेग महबलाः ।ददृशुः कपिलम् तत्र वासुदेवम् सनातनम् ॥१-४०-२५॥
transliteration: te tu sarve mahatmāno bhimavega mahabalāḥ ।dadṛśuḥ kapilam tatra vāsudevam sanātanam ॥1-40-25॥

translations.english: Great sons of Sagara terribly swiftfooted and exceedingly powerful beheld the eternal Visnu in (sage) Kapila and not far away from him the horse grazing. O descendant of Raghu they all experienced unparalleled joy.
